accepted_reliable_secondary_evidence: 2024 Journal of Home Economics of Japan peer-reviewed paper supplies PCCS hue-difference regions through complementary difference.
2026 J-STAGE emotion research independently confirms hue difference 1 = 隣接 and 2-3 = 類似, and gives a PCCS contrast-tone definition plus a concrete b/dk example.

2019 工学教育 peer-reviewed Kanazawa Institute of Technology paper, explicitly grounded in color-certification teaching material, defines 類似トーン as adjacent tones and supplies a coordinate-based adjacency judgment.
